(rule!
 ;; A modal-color separator lattice contains one ordinary tile pattern and
 ;; repeated copies of one anomalous tile.  The anomalous tile introduces one
 ;; new ink color.  Its ink cells form a micro mask; translate that same mask
 ;; over macro-tile coordinates so that it covers every anomalous clue tile,
 ;; then copy the complete anomalous tile into every selected macro position.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define scope-mode 0)
   (define bg (pick-max (grid-colors g) (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
   (define sep-rows
    (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) bg)) (range 0 (cols g))))
            (range 0 (rows g))))
   (define sep-cols
    (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) bg)) (range 0 (rows g))))
            (range 0 (cols g))))
   (define (bands separators)
    (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
     (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length separators) 1))))
      (list (+ (list-ref separators i) 1)
            (- (list-ref separators (+ i 1)) 1)))))
   (define row-bands (bands sep-rows))
   (define col-bands (bands sep-cols))
   (define records
    (for*/list ((ri (range 0 (length row-bands)))
                (ci (range 0 (length col-bands))))
     (let ((rb (list-ref row-bands ri)) (cb (list-ref col-bands ci)))
      (list ri ci (subgrid g (first rb) (first cb) (second rb) (second cb))))))
   (define base-record
    (pick-max records
     (lambda (rec)
      (count-if (lambda (other) (equal? (third rec) (third other))) records))))
   (define base (third base-record))
   (define anomalies (filter (lambda (rec) (not (equal? (third rec) base))) records))
   (define anomaly (third (first anomalies)))
   (define base-colors (grid-colors base))
   (define ink
    (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v base-colors))) (grid-colors anomaly))))
   (define full-mask (find-color anomaly ink))
   (define mask-grid (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows anomaly) (cols anomaly) 0) full-mask 1))
   (define components (objects mask-grid 0))
   (define selected-mask
    (if (= scope-mode 0)
        full-mask
        (obj-cells (pick-max components obj-size))))
   (define clues (map (lambda (rec) (list (first rec) (second rec))) anomalies))
   (define anchors
    (for*/list ((ar (range 0 (+ 1 (- (length row-bands) (rows anomaly)))))
                (ac (range 0 (+ 1 (- (length col-bands) (cols anomaly)))))
                #:when
                (all? (lambda (q)
                        (member (list (- (first q) ar) (- (second q) ac)) full-mask))
                      clues))
     (list ar ac)))
   (define anchor (first anchors))
   (define paints
    (apply append
     (for/list ((p selected-mask))
      (let* ((mr (+ (first anchor) (first p)))
             (mc (+ (second anchor) (second p)))
             (rb (list-ref row-bands mr))
             (cb (list-ref col-bands mc)))
       (for*/list ((r (range 0 (rows anomaly))) (c (range 0 (cols anomaly))))
        (list (+ (first rb) r) (+ (first cb) c) (at anomaly r c)))))))
   (paint-cells g paints))))

   (define sep-rows
    (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) bg)) (range 0 (cols g))))
            (range 0 (rows g))))
   (define sep-cols
    (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) bg)) (range 0 (rows g))))
            (range 0 (cols g))))
   (define (bands separators)
    (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
     (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length separators) 1))))
      (list (+ (list-ref separators i) 1)
            (- (list-ref separators (+ i 1)) 1)))))
   (define row-bands (bands sep-rows))
   (define col-bands (bands sep-cols))
   (define records
    (for*/list ((ri (range 0 (length row-bands)))
                (ci (range 0 (length col-bands))))
     (let ((rb (list-ref row-bands ri)) (cb (list-ref col-bands ci)))
      (list ri ci (subgrid g (first rb) (first cb) (second rb) (second cb))))))
   (define base-record
    (pick-max records
     (lambda (rec)
      (count-if (lambda (other) (equal? (third rec) (third other))) records))))
   (define base (third base-record))
   (define anomalies (filter (lambda (rec) (not (equal? (third rec) base))) records))
   (define anomaly (third (first anomalies)))
   (define base-colors (grid-colors base))
   (define ink
    (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v base-colors))) (grid-colors anomaly))))
   (define full-mask (find-color anomaly ink))
   (define mask-grid (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows anomaly) (cols anomaly) 0) full-mask 1))
   (define components (objects mask-grid 0))
   (define selected-mask
    (if (= scope-mode 0)
        full-mask
        (obj-cells (pick-max components obj-size))))
   (define clues (map (lambda (rec) (list (first rec) (second rec))) anomalies))
   (define anchors
    (for*/list ((ar (range 0 (+ 1 (- (length row-bands) (rows anomaly)))))
                (ac (range 0 (+ 1 (- (length col-bands) (cols anomaly)))))
                #:when
                (all? (lambda (q)
                        (member (list (- (first q) ar) (- (second q) ac)) full-mask))
                      clues))
     (list ar ac)))
   (define anchor (first anchors))
   (define dense-row (pick-max (sort (remove-duplicates (map first selected-mask)) <) (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) r)) selected-mask))))
   (define paints
    (apply append
     (for/list ((p selected-mask))
      (let* ((mr (+ (first anchor) (first p)))
             (mc (+ (second anchor) (second p)))
             (rb (list-ref row-bands mr))
             (cb (list-ref col-bands mc)))
       (for*/list ((r (range 0 (rows anomaly))) (c (range 0 (cols anomaly))))
        (list (+ (first rb) r) (+ (first cb) c) (if (and (= (first p) dense-row) (= (at anomaly r c) ink)) 9 (at anomaly r c))))))))
   (paint-cells g paints))))

(rule!
 ;; A separator lattice contains a majority normal tile and a minority special
 ;; tile. The special tile's one novel color encodes a small occupancy mask.
 ;; Find the unique translation of that mask on the macro tile grid containing
 ;; every observed special tile, then fill its missing positions with exact
 ;; special-tile copies. Separator thickness and palette are not hardcoded.
 ;; The fill-holes alternative first completes the macro copy, then fills its
 ;; four-connected enclosed background components. The fill-before ablation
 ;; measures those cavities on the incomplete arrangement instead.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define completion-policy "fill_holes")
     (define separator (at g 0 0))
     (define (row-line r) (for/and ((c (range w))) (= (at g r c) separator)))
     (define (col-line c) (for/and ((r (range h))) (= (at g r c) separator)))
     (define (row-end r) (if (and (< r h) (not (row-line r))) (row-end (+ r 1)) r))
     (define (col-end c) (if (and (< c w) (not (col-line c))) (col-end (+ c 1)) c))
     (define row-runs
       (for/list ((r (range h)) #:when (and (not (row-line r)) (or (= r 0) (row-line (- r 1)))))
         (range r (row-end r))))
     (define col-runs
       (for/list ((c (range w)) #:when (and (not (col-line c)) (or (= c 0) (col-line (- c 1)))))
         (range c (col-end c))))
     (define macro-h (length row-runs))
     (define macro-w (length col-runs))
     (define tile-h (length (first row-runs)))
     (define tile-w (length (first col-runs)))
     (define tiles
       (for*/list ((r (range macro-h)) (c (range macro-w)))
         (let ((rr (list-ref row-runs r)) (cc (list-ref col-runs c)))
           (list r c (subgrid g (first rr) (first cc) (last rr) (last cc))))))
     (define kinds (remove-duplicates (map third tiles)))
     (define normal
       (pick-max kinds (lambda (tile) (length (filter (lambda (p) (equal? (third p) tile)) tiles)))))
     (define special (first (filter (lambda (tile) (not (equal? tile normal))) kinds)))
     (define foreground
       (first (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v separator)) (not (member v (grid-colors normal)))))
                      (grid-colors special))))
     (define mask (find-color special foreground))
     (define observed (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (second p)))
                           (filter (lambda (p) (equal? (third p) special)) tiles)))
     (define (shifted r c)
       (map (lambda (p) (list (+ r (first p)) (+ c (second p)))) mask))
     (define placements
       (for*/list ((r (range (+ 1 (- macro-h tile-h)))) (c (range (+ 1 (- macro-w tile-w))))
                   #:when (for/and ((p observed)) (member p (shifted r c))))
         (list r c)))
     (define anchor (first placements))
     (define target (shifted (first anchor) (second anchor)))
     (define (cavities occupied)
       (let* ((binary (grid-from-fn macro-h macro-w
                         (lambda (r c) (if (member (list r c) occupied) 1 0))))
              (inside (filter (lambda (o) (and (> (obj-r1 o) 0) (> (obj-c1 o) 0)
                                               (< (obj-r2 o) (- macro-h 1)) (< (obj-c2 o) (- macro-w 1))))
                              (objects binary 1))))
         (apply append (map obj-cells inside))))
     (define extra
       (cond ((equal? completion-policy "fill_holes") (cavities target))
             ((equal? completion-policy "fill_before") (cavities observed))
             (else '())))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((p (remove-duplicates (append target extra))))
       (let ((rr (list-ref row-runs (first p))) (cc (list-ref col-runs (second p))))
         (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range tile-h)) (c (range tile-w)))
           (set-cell acc (list-ref rr r) (list-ref cc c) (at special r c))))))))
